_notes.vin_structure: 17 chars: pos1-3=WMI, pos4-8=VDS, pos9=check_digit, pos10=model_year, pos11=plant, pos12-17=serial
_notes.how_to_use: 1) Decode pos10 using model_year_codes. 2) Check era: pre-2001 vs post-2001 SWAPS pos5/pos6 roles. 3) Pre-2001: pos5=body_style, pos6=trim. Post-2001: pos5=trim, pos6=body_type. Always check year first.
_notes.era_split_note: CRITICAL: pos5 and pos6 swap roles at MY2001. Pre-2001 (MY1996-2000) and some 01-05 models (Sonata, 01 Tiburon): pos5=body, pos6=trim. All others MY2001+: pos5=trim, pos6=body.
_notes.excluded: Pre-1996 excluded — outside active 30-year VIN cycle (1996-2026)
_notes.gcc_note: GCC Hyundai mostly KMH (Korean-built). India-sourced (MAL): i10, i20, Creta. MAL Creta has parts-availability implications.
_notes.check_digit_note: US-market (5NP/5NM): NHTSA check digit always. Korean GCC (KMH/KM8): may be check digit or manufacturer filler.

position_9_check_digit._note: Check digit: 0-9 or X. Calculated by substituting letters for numbers, multiplying by weight factors, summing, dividing by 11. Remainder=check digit; remainder 10=X.

era_detection._note: Use model year from pos10 to pick correct era for pos5/pos6 decoding.

pre_2001_plus_exceptions.description: pos5=body_style, pos6=trim. Applies to: MY1996-2000 ALL models + MY2001-2005 Sonata + MY2001 Tiburon.

post_2001_standard.description: pos5=trim_level, pos6=body_type. Applies to: MY2000 Accent (00 Accent only) + all MY2001-2026 EXCEPT 01-05 Sonata & 01 Tiburon.
